build_pidinet_model: build a PiDiNet model for precise image edge detection using the pidinet factory function
run_edge_detection: run edge detection on an input image tensor using a loaded PiDiNet model
create_pdc_block: create a PDCBlock with configurable pattern difference convolution types like cd, ad, or rd
convert_pdc_to_vanilla: convert CPDC, APDC, or RPDC blocks to equivalent vanilla convolution layers using PDCBlock_converted
configure_model_variant: configure a PiDiNet model variant by selecting from predefined nets like carv4, c16, or a16
